itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Istanbul, our team will be on hand to welcome you and transfer you to your hotel. The remainder of the day is free for you to relax. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour (B, L)
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, we collect you from your hotel for a full-day guided walking tour through historic Sultanahmet. You will visit the Sultanahmet (Blue) Mosque, Hagia Sophia, the ancient Hippodrome with its Obelisk of Theodosius, Serpent Column and German Fountain, the Grand Bazaar, Topkapı Palace, and Hagia Eirene Church. At the end of the tour you will be accompanied back to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight to Cappadocia – Full Day North Cappadocia (Red) Tour (B, L)
itinerary.description: An early morning transfer takes you to the airport for your flight to Cappadocia. Upon arrival, our team greets you and the full-day North Cappadocia Tour begins. Highlights include the Göreme Open Air Museum—home to five exceptional Byzantine Orthodox churches—the fantastical rock formations of Devrent Valley and Paşabağ, and the ancient towns of Ürgüp and Avanos, where you will have the chance to try your hand at traditional red-clay pottery following a live demonstration. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Full Day South Cappadocia (Green) Tour – Night Bus to Antalya (B, L)
itinerary.description: An optional hot air balloon ride at sunrise is available this morning. Following breakfast and check-out, the full-day South Cappadocia Tour begins, visiting the Red and Rose Valleys, the ancient cave-house village of Çavuşin, Love Valley, Kaymaklı Underground City, Pigeon Valley, and Uçhisar Castle. At the end of the tour, you are transferred to our office before boarding the overnight bus to Antalya—a comfortable ten-hour journey through the Anatolian heartland.

itinerary.title: Full Day Perge, Aspendos & Manavgat Waterfall Tour (L)
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Antalya bus station, our team meets you and transfers you to the office before the day's tour begins. You will first visit Perge, an important ancient city of Pamphylia founded—according to tradition—by Greek settlers following the Trojan War. Its Hellenistic monuments are among the most impressive in the region. Next comes Aspendos, whose Roman theatre is widely considered one of the finest surviving examples of Roman imperial architecture anywhere in the world. The day concludes at the spectacular Manavgat Waterfall, one of the most impressive natural sights in the Antalya region. You are returned to your hotel at the end of the day. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Free Day to Discover Antalya (B)
itinerary.description: Today is entirely yours. Antalya is a city of extraordinary contrasts—wander through the cobbled lanes and Roman harbour of Kaleiçi, stroll along the cliff-top promenade, visit the city's excellent archaeological museum, or simply relax by the sea. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Antalya – Afternoon Transfer to Pamukkale (B)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you have a further free morning to enjoy Antalya at your own pace. Following check-out, we transfer you to the bus terminal for the four-hour journey to Pamukkale. Upon arrival, our team welcomes you and transfers you to your hotel. Overnight in Pamukkale.

itinerary.title: Full Day Pamukkale & Hierapolis Tour (B, L)
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, the full-day Pamukkale and Hierapolis Tour begins. Mineral-rich springs cascading from a cliff face nearly 200 metres high have sculpted Pamukkale's iconic landscape of gleaming travertine terraces—an otherworldly panorama of petrified waterfalls and natural thermal pools. Alongside, the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hierapolis preserves millennia of sacred history, including a vast Necropolis with the Sarcophagus of a general of Marcus Aurelius, and the celebrated Cleopatra Swimming Pool, where visitors may bathe among ancient submerged columns. At the conclusion of the tour, you are transferred to your hotel in Kuşadası. Overnight in Kuşadası.

itinerary.title: Full Day Ephesus Tour – Flight to Istanbul (B, L)
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, the full-day Ephesus Tour gets underway. Among the highlights are the Temple of Artemis—one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World; the Library of Celsus, erected in honour of the Roman senator Tiberius Julius Celsus Polemaeanus and serving as both a monument and his mausoleum; the extraordinary ruins of Ephesus Ancient City; and the House of the Virgin Mary, believed to be where she spent her final years. You will also pass through ancient theatres, hammams, and the marble-paved harbour street. At the end of the tour, you are transferred to İzmir Airport for your evening flight to Istanbul. Upon arrival, our team welcomes you and transfers you to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul (B)
itinerary.description: Following breakfast and check-out, you are transferred to the international airport in time for your departure flight. We trust this ten-day journey through Turkey's greatest treasures has been an experience to cherish.

description.en: An early morning transfer brings you to the airport for your flight to Cappadocia. description.en: Following an optional hot air balloon ride, the full-day South Cappadocia tour begins. Highlights include a hike through the Red and Rose Valleys, cave-house village of Çavuşin, Love Valley, Kaymakli Underground City, Pigeon Valley, and Uçhisar Castle. Overnight in Cappadocia.

Mevlana Müzesi'nde mistik bir soluk alıyor, ardından Pamukkale'ye hareket ediyoruz. Not: Bu gün rehber eşliği ve öğle yemeği programa dahil değildir; sürücümüz güzergâh boyunca sizinle birlikte olacaktır.
description.en: After breakfast and check-out, we set off for Pamukkale. En route, we stop in Konya—once a vital Silk Road trading hub, home to the earliest Christian sanctuaries, and the spiritual resting place of Rumi (Mevlana), founder of the Whirling Dervish tradition. We pause at the Mevlana Museum before continuing to Pamukkale. Note: No guide or included lunch on this day; our driver accompanies you throughout.

title.tr: Tam Gün Pamukkale & Hierapolis Turu

description.en: After breakfast and check-out, the full-day Pamukkale and Hierapolis tour gets underway. UNESCO World Heritage Site Hierapolis draws you through its ancient city, Necropolis, and the legendary Cleopatra Swimming Pool. You spend the night at a beautiful hotel or resort in Kuşadası.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival in Istanbul, our team will be on hand to welcome you and transfer you to your hotel. The remainder of the day is free to relax and acclimatise. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Full Day Istanbul Old City Walking Tour (B, L)
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, we collect you for a full-day guided walking tour of historic Sultanahmet. You will visit the Sultanahmet (Blue) Mosque, Hagia Sophia, the ancient Hippodrome with its Obelisk of Theodosius, Serpent Column and German Fountain, the Grand Bazaar, Topkapı Palace, and Hagia Eirene Church. At the end of the day you will be accompanied back to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Istanbul (B)
itinerary.description: Today is entirely yours to explore Istanbul at your own pace. Consider a Bosphorus ferry ride, a visit to the Galata Tower, a stroll through the vibrant Karaköy or Balat neighbourhoods, or simply wander the bazaars at leisure. Our team is available for recommendations. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Full Day Gallipoli Tour (L)
itinerary.description: At approximately 6:30 AM, you depart from the hotel for the roughly five-hour journey to the Gallipoli Peninsula. An optional breakfast stop is available along the way. Following lunch at a traditional local restaurant, the tour visits: Brighton Beach, Beach Cemetery (John Simpson's Grave), ANZAC Cove, Arı Burnu (the first ANZAC landing point), Lone Pine Cemetery (the Australian memorial), Johnston's Jolly (with a walk through the ANZAC trenches), Shrapnel Valley overlook, the Turkish Memorial, The Nek, Walker's Ridge, and Chunuk Bair (the principal New Zealand memorial). At the end of the day, you board the ferry to Çanakkale. Overnight in Çanakkale.

itinerary.title: Full Day Troy & Pergamum Tour – Transfer to Kuşadası (B, L)
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, you depart for ancient Troy—one of history's most legendary archaeological sites. You will see the ingeniously crafted Trojan Horse and explore the layered remains of more than seven cities built one atop another over millennia, dating back to 3500 BC, including the Temple of Apollo, ancient fortification walls, the battlefield of Hector and Achilles, and the Greco-Roman theatre that once hosted assemblies of democratic delegates. The tour then continues to Pergamum (Bergama) for lunch, followed by a visit to its celebrated ancient city and acropolis—one of the ancient world's greatest centres of learning and culture. In the evening, you are transferred to Kuşadası. Overnight in Kuşadası.

itinerary.title: Full Day Ephesus Tour (B, L)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your full-day Ephesus Tour begins. Highlights include the Temple of Artemis—one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World; the Library of Celsus, a monument and mausoleum built in honour of the Roman senator Tiberius Julius Celsus Polemaeanus; the sweeping ruins of Ephesus Ancient City; and the House of the Virgin Mary, believed by many to be where she spent her final years. The route also passes through ancient theatres, hammams, and the marble-paved harbour street. You are returned to your hotel at the end of the day. Overnight in Kuşadası.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Kuşadası (B)
itinerary.description: A day entirely at your disposal. Kuşadası is an ideal base for exploring the surrounding area—browse the town's lively bazaar, relax on the beach, or consider a day trip to the Greek island of Samos, just a short ferry ride away. Our team is happy to assist with any recommendations. Overnight in Kuşadası.

itinerary.title: Full Day Pamukkale & Hierapolis Tour – Transfer to Fethiye (B, L)
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, we depart for Pamukkale and Hierapolis. Mineral-rich springs cascading from a cliff face nearly 200 metres high have created Pamukkale's iconic landscape of gleaming travertine terraces—an otherworldly panorama of petrified waterfalls and natural thermal pools. Alongside, the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hierapolis preserves millennia of sacred history, including a vast Necropolis with the Sarcophagus of a general of Marcus Aurelius, and the celebrated Cleopatra Swimming Pool, where visitors may bathe among ancient submerged columns. At the conclusion of the tour, you are transferred to your hotel in Fethiye. Overnight in Fethiye.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Fethiye (B)
itinerary.description: Fethiye is one of the most beautiful towns on the Turquoise Coast, and today is yours to explore it. Wander the bustling market, visit the ancient Lycian rock tombs carved into the cliffs above the town, or take a local boat out to the stunning Blue Lagoon at Ölüdeniz. Our team can suggest the best options based on your interests. Overnight in Fethiye.

itinerary.title: Blue Cruise Day 1: Fethiye – Butterfly Valley – Ölüdeniz – St. Nicholas Island (L, D)
itinerary.description: At approximately 9:00 AM you are transferred from your hotel to our office for check-in and a pre-departure briefing. Between 11:00 AM and 12:00 PM, the gulet departs for Butterfly Valley—a remarkable eco-tourism haven home to some 105 butterfly species—where you enjoy swimming, lunch, and an optional hike to the waterfall. The cruise then continues to Ölüdeniz, one of the most photographed beaches in the world. An optional paragliding excursion departs from Babadağ Mountain at 2,000 metres, offering unparalleled views over the Blue Lagoon in one of the world's premier paragliding locations. The evening is spent at anchor off St. Nicholas Island, where you may explore ancient ruins and enjoy the sunset.

itinerary.title: Blue Cruise Day 2: St. Nicholas Island – Kalkan – Kaş (B, L, D)
itinerary.description: You wake up anchored just outside Kalkan for a morning swim and breakfast before sailing to Kaş—a charming fishing village celebrated for its boutique jewellery shops, handcrafted textiles, and cosy cafés. For those interested, an optional scuba diving excursion is available in the crystal-clear waters of the Southern Mediterranean, with specialist sites including cave dives and wreck dives. The night is spent at anchor in a secluded bay between Kaş and Kekova.

itinerary.title: Blue Cruise Day 3: Kekova Sunken City – Simena Castle – Gökkaya Bay (B, L, D)
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, the gulet glides over the submerged ruins of Kekova Sunken City, a protected Lycian-Roman archaeological site where, as a UNESCO heritage area, swimming and diving are not permitted—but the views from on board are extraordinary. You then anchor to visit Simena Castle for a sweeping panorama over the bay. The evening is spent in Gökkaya Bay, where you may join the lively Smuggler's Inn—a celebrated gathering point for travellers from across the anchorage, with dancing under the stars and a regular water-taxi service throughout the night. Those preferring a quieter evening are equally welcome to relax aboard the gulet.

itinerary.title: Blue Cruise Day 4: Gökkaya Bay – Demre – Transfer to Antalya (B)
itinerary.description: The final morning of the cruise begins with a refreshing swim. After breakfast, the gulet heads past Pirates Cave en route to Demre Harbour (Andriake Harbour), arriving before noon. After farewells to your crew and fellow travellers, you are transferred by road to your hotel in Antalya. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Full Day Perge, Aspendos & Manavgat Waterfall Tour (B, L)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your full-day tour of ancient Pamphylia begins. You will first visit Perge, one of the most important cities of the ancient Pamphylian plain, founded—according to tradition—by Greek settlers following the Trojan War, with exceptional Hellenistic and Roman monuments. Next comes Aspendos, whose Roman theatre is widely regarded as one of the finest surviving examples of Roman imperial architecture in existence. The day concludes at the spectacular Manavgat Waterfall, one of the most impressive natural sights in the Antalya region. You are returned to your hotel at the end of the day. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Antalya (B)
itinerary.description: Antalya is a city of remarkable contrasts, and today you are free to discover it as you wish. Explore the Roman harbour and Ottoman lanes of Kaleiçi, visit the outstanding Antalya Archaeological Museum, stroll along the cliff-top promenade, or simply relax by the sea. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cappadocia via Konya (B)
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, we depart for Cappadocia with a cultural stop in Konya—one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world. Konya was home to one of the earliest Christian settlements in Anatolia and is celebrated as the spiritual home of Rumi (Mevlâna), the 13th-century Sufi mystic and poet who founded the Whirling Dervish tradition. It was also a pivotal trading hub on the ancient Silk Road. You will visit the Mevlâna Museum—the former lodge of the Mevlevi Order and Rumi's final resting place. After exploring Konya, a three-hour minibus transfer takes you onward to Cappadocia. Please note: a guide is not included on this travel day, though our driver will be with you throughout. Lunch is at your own expense; our driver can recommend excellent local restaurants near the museum. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Full Day North Cappadocia (Red) Tour (B, L)
itinerary.description: An optional hot air balloon ride at sunrise is available this morning. Following breakfast, you are collected for the full-day North Cappadocia Tour. Highlights include the Göreme Open Air Museum with its five Byzantine Orthodox churches, the extraordinary rock formations of Devrent Valley and Paşabağ—where fairy chimneys take the shapes of animals and mythical figures—and the ancient towns of Ürgüp and Avanos, celebrated for its centuries-old tradition of red-clay pottery. You will have the opportunity to try making pottery yourself following a live demonstration. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Full Day South Cappadocia (Green) Tour – Flight to Istanbul (B, L)
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, the full-day South Cappadocia Tour gets underway, taking in a hike through the Red and Rose Valleys, the ancient cave-house village of Çavuşin, Love Valley, Kaymaklı Underground City, Pigeon Valley, and Uçhisar Castle. At the conclusion of the tour, you are transferred to the airport for your flight back to Istanbul. Upon arrival, our team welcomes you and transfers you to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Istanbul (B)
itinerary.description: Your final full day in Turkey is yours to spend however you choose. Perhaps a Bosphorus cruise, a relaxing afternoon in a traditional Turkish hammam, a final wander through the Grand Bazaar, or time to pick up last-minute souvenirs for family and friends. Our team remains available for any further recommendations. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul (B)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the international airport in accordance with your departure flight time. Twenty days, countless memories—we hope Turkey has left its mark on you, and that we will have the pleasure of welcoming you back.

title.tr: Trabzon'a Varış – Ayasofya & Sümela Manastırı
title.en: Arrival in Trabzon – Hagia Sophia & Sumela Monastery

description.tr: Trabzon'a varışınızın ardından, Karadeniz'e nazır büyüleyici 14. yüzyıl Bizans yapıtı Ayasofya Kilisesi ile turu açıyoruz. Tarihi freskler ve benzersiz mimarisi bölgenin Hristiyan mirasını gözler önüne seriyor. Ardından Altındere Milli Parkı'nda çam ormanları ve şelaleler arasına yükselen efsanevi Sümela Manastırı'nı keşfediyoruz. Günü sahil boyunca Gürcistan sınırına yakın Hopa'da noktalıyoruz.
description.en: We open our journey with a visit to the breathtaking 14th-century Byzantine Hagia Sophia Church, perched above the Black Sea. Its historic frescoes and singular architecture bear witness to the region's Christian heritage. Next, we head to Altındere National Park to discover the legendary Sumela Monastery, dramatically clinging to a clifftop amid pine forests and cascading waterfalls. We conclude the day in Hopa, near the Georgian border.

title.tr: Artvin & Gürcü Vadileri Üzerinden Erzurum'a
title.en: Scenic Drive to Erzurum via Artvin & Georgian Valleys

description.tr: Hopa'dan ayrılarak Artvin ve muhteşem Gürcü Vadileri arasında nefes kesen bir yolculuğa çıkıyoruz. Orta Çağ Gürcü Krallığı'ndan kalma tarihi taş kilisesiyle İşhan'da mola veriyoruz. Derin nehir kanyonları ve ormanlık zirvelerin eşliğinde Selçuklu mimarisi, tarihi camiler ve canlı çarşılarıyla ünlü Erzurum'a ulaşıyoruz.
description.en: Departing Hopa, we embark on a breathtaking drive through Artvin and the spectacular Georgian Valleys, pausing at Ishan to admire its medieval stone church—a relic of the Georgian Kingdom. We wind through dramatic river gorges and forested peaks before arriving in Erzurum, celebrated for its Seljuk architecture, historic mosques, and vibrant bazaars.

title.tr: Erzurum Şehir Turu & Ani Harabeleri Üzerinden Kars
title.en: Erzurum City Tour & Journey to Kars via Ani Ruins

description.tr: Kahvaltının ardından Erzurum'u keşfediyoruz: Ulu Cami, Çifte Minareli Medrese ve geleneksel Oltu taşı el sanatlarıyla ünlü renkli çarşılar... Ardından Aras Nehri Vadisi boyunca Kars'a hareket ediyoruz. I. Dünya Savaşı'ndan kalma tarihi Sarıkamış Savaş Alanı'nı geçip Bagratid Ermeni Krallığı'nın eski başkenti Ani'ye ulaşıyoruz. Arpaçay Nehri kıyısında yükselen katedral ve cami kalıntıları görkemini bugün de koruyor.
description.en: After breakfast, we explore Erzurum's highlights: the Grand Mosque, the twin-minareted Çifte Minareli Medrese, and colourful bazaars famous for traditional Oltu stone crafts. We then head for Kars along the Aras River Valley, passing the historic WWI Sarıkamış Battlefield, before reaching Ani—once the magnificent capital of the Bagratid Armenian Kingdom—where cathedral and mosque ruins still stand majestically along the Arpaçay River.

title.tr: Ağrı Dağı, İshak Paşa Sarayı & Van'a Varış
title.en: Mount Ararat, Ishak Pasha Palace & Arrival in Van

description.tr: Nuh'un Gemisi'nin durağı olduğuna inanılan efsanevi Ağrı Dağı'nı geçerek Doğubayazıt'a ilerliyoruz. Osmanlı, Fars ve Selçuklu üsluplarının eşsiz senteziyle inşa edilmiş İshak Paşa Sarayı'nı ziyaret ediyoruz. Günü, göl manzarası ve canlı yerel kültürüyle büyüleyici Van şehrinde tamamlıyoruz.
description.en: Journeying east, we pass the legendary Mount Ararat—believed to be the resting place of Noah's Ark—and arrive in Doğubayazıt to visit the magnificent Ishak Pasha Palace, an extraordinary architectural fusion of Ottoman, Persian, and Seljuk styles. We close the day in Van, a city of captivating lake views and vibrant local culture.

title.tr: Hoşap Kalesi, Van Gölü & Akdamar Adası
title.en: Van, Hoşap Fortress & Akdamar Island Tour

description.tr: Sabahın ilk saatlerinde, Tarihi İpek Yolu güzergâhı üzerindeki 17. yüzyıldan kalma heybetli Hoşap Kalesi'ni ziyaret ediyoruz. Öğleden sonra, Van Gölü'nü geçen keyifli bir tekne yolculuğuyla Akdamar Adası'na ulaşıyoruz. Burada, etkileyici İncil sahnelerinin taş kabartmalarıyla süslenmiş 10. yüzyıl Ermeni şaheseri Kutsal Haç Kilisesi'ni keşfediyoruz.
description.en: We begin with a visit to the imposing Hoşap Fortress, a 17th-century stronghold that once guarded the ancient Silk Road. In the afternoon, a scenic boat crossing over Lake Van brings us to Akdamar Island, where we explore the Church of the Holy Cross—a 10th-century Armenian masterpiece adorned with stunning biblical stone reliefs.

title.tr: Tatvan, Nemrut Krateri & Ahlat Selçuklu Anıtları
title.en: Tatvan, Nemrut Crater & Ahlat Seljuk Monuments

description.tr: Van Gölü'nün güney kıyıları boyunca ilerleyerek Tatvan'a ulaşıyoruz. Dünyanın en büyük volkanik kalderalarından biri olan Nemrut Krateri; mavi krater gölleri, jeotermal kaynaklar ve yabani çiçeklerle görsel bir şölen sunuyor. Ardından Ahlat'a geçerek UNESCO tarafından tescillenen Selçuklu Kümbetleri ve Mezarlığı'nı ziyaret ediyoruz; bu anıtlar Anadolu'nun en önemli İslam mimarlığı örnekleri arasında yer alıyor.
description.en: We trace the southern shores of Lake Van to the charming town of Tatvan, then ascend to the remarkable Nemrut Crater—one of the world's largest volcanic calderas—where turquoise crater lakes, hot springs, and wildflowers create a truly otherworldly landscape. We continue to Ahlat to visit the UNESCO-recognised Seljuk Tombstones and Mausoleums, among the most significant Islamic monuments in all of Anatolia.

title.tr: Hasankeyf, Midyat Gümüş Çarşısı & Mardin
title.en: Hasankeyf, Midyat Silver Bazaar & Arrival in Mardin

description.tr: Bitlis Boğazı'nı geçerek Dicle Nehri kıyısında mağaraları, köprü kalıntıları ve kalesiyle tarihe meydan okuyan Hasankeyf'e varıyoruz. Midyat'ta, ustaların yüzyıllık geleneklerle işlediği el yapımı mücevherleriyle ünlü Gümüş Çarşısı'nı geziyoruz. Akşam, Mezopotamya ovalarına hakim 15. yüzyıldan kalma Kasımiye Medresesi ile Mardin'e merhaba diyoruz.
description.en: Driving through the Bitlis Gorge, we arrive at ancient Hasankeyf—a Silk Road gem whose caves, ruined bridges, and clifftop castle still rise defiantly above the Tigris. In Midyat, we wander the celebrated Silver Bazaar, where artisans craft exquisite jewellery using centuries-old techniques. By evening, we reach Mardin and visit the graceful Kasımiye Medrese, a 15th-century theological school commanding panoramic views over the Mesopotamian plains.

title.tr: Safran Manastırı & Diyarbakır
title.en: Saffron Monastery & Diyarbakır Tour

description.tr: Günümüze tarihin derinliklerinden ulaşan Deyrü'z-Zafaran (Safran) Manastırı'nı ziyaret ediyoruz; 3.000 yıllık bir güneş tapınağının üzerine inşa edilen bu yapı, 'düz kemer' taş çatısıyla gerçek bir mimari mucize. Ardından Mezopotamya'nın en eski şehirlerinden Diyarbakır'a geçerek Dicle Nehri üzerindeki ünlü On Gözlü Köprü'yü hayranlıkla izliyoruz.
description.en: We visit the historic Deir-Al-Zafaran (Saffron) Monastery, once the spiritual heart of the Syriac Orthodox Patriarchate. Built upon a 3,000-year-old sun temple, its remarkable 'flat arch' stone ceiling stands as a true feat of ancient engineering. We then journey to Diyarbakır—one of Mesopotamia's oldest cities—to admire the famous Ten-Arch Bridge spanning the mighty Tigris River.

title.tr: Diyarbakır Tarihi Merkezi & Nemrut Dağı Günbatımı
title.en: Diyarbakır Old Town & Mount Nemrut Sunset

description.tr: Diyarbakır'ın tarihi çekirdeğini keşfediyoruz: Ulu Cami, Aziz Thomas Kilisesi ve UNESCO Dünya Mirası Listesi'ndeki şehir surları... Öğleden sonra, feribot ile Fırat Nehri'ni geçerek Nemrut Milli Parkı'na yöneliyoruz. Narlıca Köyü'nden zirveye tırmanan patikada, Kommagene Krallığı'na ait kolossal heykellerle yüz yüze geliyoruz ve ömür boyu unutamayacağınız bir günbatımına tanıklık ediyoruz.
description.en: We explore the historic core of Diyarbakır, visiting the Ulu Cami, the Church of St. Thomas, and the UNESCO-listed city walls. In the afternoon, we cross the Euphrates by ferry and head to Nemrut National Park, where a mountain hike from Narlıca Village leads us to the Colossal Statues of the Commagene Kingdom—and a sunset experience that will stay with you forever.

title.tr: Göbeklitepe, Karahan Tepe & Şanlıurfa
title.en: Göbekli Tepe, Karahan Tepe & Şanlıurfa

description.tr: İnsanlık tarihini yeniden yazan Göbeklitepe'ye adım atıyoruz: 11.000–13.000 yıllık bu olağanüstü arkeolojik kompleks, Stonehenge'den ve Giza Piramitleri'nden çok daha eski. Kardeş site Karahan Tepe'yi de ziyaret ettikten sonra Hz. İbrahim'in kutsal havuzlarını ve peygamberin doğduğuna inanılan mağarayı geziyoruz.
description.en: We step into Göbekli Tepe, the world's oldest known temple complex at 11,000–13,000 years old—predating Stonehenge and the Pyramids of Giza, and fundamentally rewriting our understanding of human civilisation. After visiting its sister site Karahan Tepe, we explore the Sacred Pools of Abraham and the venerated cave believed to be the Prophet's birthplace.

title.tr: Şanlıurfa Çarşısı, Arkeoloji Müzesi & Zeugma Mozaikleri
title.en: Şanlıurfa Bazaar, Archaeology Museum & Zeugma Mosaics

description.tr: Şanlıurfa'nın Osmanlı çarşısında baharat, dokuma ve el sanatları arasında dolaşıyoruz. Ardından, Göbeklitepe ve Mezopotamya dönemine ait paha biçilmez eserlere ev sahipliği yapan Şanlıurfa Arkeoloji Müzesi'ni ziyaret ediyoruz. Gaziantep'e geçerek, bugüne kadar keşfedilen en görkemli Roma mozaiklerine ev sahipliği yapan ünlü Zeugma Mozaik Müzesi'nde nefes kesici koleksiyonlarla karşılaşıyoruz.
description.en: We meander through Şanlıurfa's Ottoman Bazaar, alive with spices, textiles, and handcrafted goods, before visiting the city's outstanding Archaeology Museum, home to priceless artefacts from Göbekli Tepe and the Mesopotamian era. We then travel to Gaziantep to explore the world-renowned Zeugma Mosaic Museum, housing some of the finest and most breathtaking Roman mosaics ever unearthed.

title.tr: Uğurlama & Ayrılış
title.en: Farewell & Departure

description.tr: Kahvaltının ardından sizi havalimanına transfer ediyoruz. Karadeniz'den Doğu Anadolu'ya uzanan bu 12 günlük unutulmaz yolculuk; nefes kesen manzaralar, binlerce yıllık kadim eserler ve kültürel zenginliklerle dopdolu anılarla sona eriyor.
description.en: Following breakfast, we transfer you to the airport for your onward flight. Your unforgettable 12-day odyssey—from the Black Sea coast to the depths of Eastern Anatolia—comes to a close, leaving you with breathtaking landscapes, ancient wonders, and cultural treasures to cherish for a lifetime.

title.tr: İstanbul'dan Kapadokya'ya Uçuş – Kuzey Kapadokya (Kırmızı) Turu
title.en: Flight from Istanbul to Cappadocia – Full Day North Cappadocia (Red) Tour

description.tr: Sabahın erken saatlerinde otelinizden havalimanına transfer edildikten sonra Kapadokya'ya uçuyorsunuz. Varışta ekibimiz sizi karşılıyor ve tam gün Kuzey Kapadokya turumuza başlıyoruz. Beş Bizans Ortodoks kilisesini barındıran Göreme Açık Hava Müzesi, hayvan ve masal figürü peri bacalarıyla büyüleyici Paşabağ ve Devrent Vadisi, kırmızı kil çömlekçiliğiyle ünlü Ürgüp ve Avanos günün öne çıkan noktaları. Avanos'ta kısa bir gösterimin ardından geleneksel çömlekçiliği deneyimliyorsunuz. Geceyi Göreme, Kapadokya'da geçiriyorsunuz.
description.en: An early morning hotel-to-airport transfer brings you to your flight to Cappadocia. Our team welcomes you on arrival and a full-day North Cappadocia tour begins. We visit the Göreme Open Air Museum with five Byzantine Orthodox churches, the enchanting fairy chimney formations of Paşabağ and Devrent Valley, and the historic towns of Ürgüp and Avanos—where a live pottery demonstration is followed by a hands-on workshop. Overnight in Göreme, Cappadocia.

title.tr: Güney Kapadokya (Yeşil) Turu – Gece Otobüsü ile Pamukkale'ye
title.en: Full Day South Cappadocia (Green) Tour – Night Bus to Pamukkale

description.tr: İsteğe bağlı sıcak hava balonu deneyiminin ardından kahvaltı ve otelden çıkışla tam gün Güney Kapadokya turumuza başlıyoruz. Kızıl ve Gül Vadisi yürüyüşü, mağara evleriyle Çavuşin Köyü, Aşk Vadisi, Kaymakli Yeraltı Şehri, Güvercinlik Vadisi ve Uçhisar Kalesi günün öne çıkan noktaları. Turun sonunda ofisimize dönüyor, geç akşam otobüs terminaline transfer edilerek 10 saatlik gece otobüsüyle Pamukkale yolculuğuna çıkıyorsunuz.
description.en: Following an optional hot air balloon ride, breakfast and check-out, the full-day South Cappadocia tour begins. Highlights include a hike through the Red and Rose Valleys, the cave-house village of Çavuşin (one of the region's oldest settlements), Love Valley, Kaymakli Underground City, Pigeon Valley, and Uçhisar Castle. After the tour we return to the office, and late evening you transfer to the bus terminal to board a 10-hour overnight coach to Pamukkale.

title.tr: Tam Gün Pamukkale & Hierapolis Turu – Denizli'den İstanbul'a Uçuş
title.en: Full Day Pamukkale & Hierapolis Tour – Flight from Denizli to Istanbul

description.tr: Denizli otogarında ekibimiz sizi isminizin yazılı tabelayla karşılıyor ve otelinize götürüyor. Tur saatine kadar dinlenmek için gündüz odası tahsis ediliyor. Kahvaltı ve otelden çıkışın ardından tam gün Pamukkale ve Hierapolis turumuz başlıyor. Yaklaşık 200 metre yüksekliğindeki kayalıklardan fışkıran kalkerli sular, mineral ormanları, taşlaşmış şelaleler ve teras havuzlarından oluşan eşsiz coğrafyayı keşfediyoruz. UNESCO Dünya Mirası Hierapolis'in antik şehri, Marcus Aurelius generali Sarkofagı'nı barındıran Nekropolü ve efsanevi Kleopatra Yüzme Havuzu ile tarihin içinde nefes alıyoruz. Turun sonunda Denizli Havalimanı'na transfer edilerek İstanbul'a dönüyorsunuz.
description.en: Our team meets you at Denizli bus station with a name sign and transfers you to the hotel, where a day-use room is provided for rest before the tour. After breakfast and check-out, the full-day Pamukkale and Hierapolis tour begins. We explore the extraordinary landscape of mineral forests, petrified waterfalls, and terraced pools created by mineral-rich springs from cliffs nearly 200 metres high. UNESCO World Heritage Site Hierapolis reveals its ancient city, the vast Necropolis (including the sarcophagus of a general of Marcus Aurelius), and the legendary Cleopatra Swimming Pool. At the tour's end, you transfer to Denizli Airport for your return flight to Istanbul.
